architecture: v4 (re-root at stage 4: a London systematic equity desk's 2027 allocation of GBP 400 million of new capital to one of three backtested UK strategies, each strategy's gross alpha netted of the market impact its rebalances would pay at that size, priced on the desk's own executions)
slot_note: re-root of task306 in the same objective (Opportunity Sizing), batch 1
niche: a London asset manager's systematic equity desk placing GBP 400 million of new 2027 capital with one of three backtested UK strategies, the alpha each keeps once its 2026 rebalances are traded at that size and priced on the impact the desk's own orders paid as their share of a stock's daily value grew
answer: Give the GBP 400 million to the UK mid-cap value strategy, which keeps about GBP 8 million of alpha a year once its rebalances are priced at that size, against the large-cap quality strategy and the small-cap momentum strategy, whose gross lead is spent on impact.
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every field and rule correctly nets each strategy's backtest gross alpha of its 2026 rebalances priced at the cost the desk's own orders paid per traded pound in stocks of the same size, and files the small-cap momentum strategy, when at GBP 400 million its month-end trades would take several per cent of each small cap's daily traded value and the desk's orders show impact rising with the square root of that share, which spends most of its gross lead.
domain_test: Capacity is systematic equity's own question: the alpha a strategy keeps net of the market impact its trades pay at the capital it runs, estimated from the desk's transaction cost analysis with impact rising with the square root of participation in the stock's daily volume; with another field's nouns there is no participation, no implementation shortfall against an arrival price and no square-root impact law to price a rebalance at a new size.
layer1: London prices quoted in pence while one broker's fills report pounds
an order's fills split across many rows, a re-sent batch repeating fills under the same execution id
order timestamps in UTC against a London trading day
stock identifiers as SEDOL in the market data and ISIN in the backtest weights, joined through the security master
share consolidations changing a stock's share count partway through the market data
cancelled orders whose unfilled remainder stays on the blotter
stakeholder_role: the desk's head of systematic equities, who puts the 2027 allocation to the investment committee

spine.entity: one fill of a desk order

world.org_type: a London asset manager's systematic equity desk

driver: The decisive quantity is what a candidate's measured edge keeps once its own activity is priced at the scale it is being given, when the cost of that activity rises with its size relative to what the market around it absorbs each day and the organisation's cost record was paid at a fraction of that scale; carrying the recorded average cost to the new scale leaves the candidate whose activity is largest against its market looking best.
driver_concrete: At GBP 400 million the small-cap momentum strategy's month-end rebalances would trade several per cent of each small cap's daily traded value, and the desk's own orders show impact rising with the square root of that share, so its 4.8 per cent gross alpha keeps about 1.3 per cent, under the mid-cap value strategy's 2.0 and the large-cap quality strategy's 1.5, while the desk's average realised cost leaves momentum first.
stump: A competent solver nets each strategy's backtest gross alpha of its 2026 turnover priced at what the desk's own orders paid for stocks of that size and gives the GBP 400 million to small-cap momentum; the step that lands it there is pricing the trades at the cost of the desk's far smaller orders, when impact grows with each trade's share of the stock's daily traded value and at GBP 400 million momentum's trades take several per cent of its small caps' volume.

differentiation.task310: task310 caps an added store's yield at a site's send-out limit, a hard ceiling on what the record let through; here nothing caps the trades, their cost rises smoothly with size against each stock's own daily volume, and the curve is fitted on the desk's own orders.
differentiation.task106: task106 shares one finite pool of spare capacity among candidates; here each candidate trades its own stocks and only one is funded, the cost is a function of its own size.
differentiation.task309: task309 carries one effect ratio across an intensity range where it varies; here the quantity carried is a cost per traded pound that varies with trade size against daily volume, measured on executions, not on outcomes.
differentiation.task118: task118 prices a resource on the consecutive day it is called; here the response is a cost curve in trade size, with no sequence in time.
differentiation.task83: task83 ranks strata of a capped retention budget by a randomized holdout's measured treatment effect, single-peaked in a risk score; here nothing is randomized or capped, one candidate is funded whole, and the carried quantity is a trading cost per pound whose level rises with the trade's share of the stock's daily traded value, fitted on the desk's own executions and applied at a scale the desk has not traded.
differentiation.task178: task178 calibrates the market's price impact on an hour's dealer flow and corrects the regression's simultaneity with customer flow as the instrument, to price options on the volatility left when the central bank stops; here nothing is instrumented and no volatility is forecast: the desk's own orders trace cost against each order's share of the stock's day, and the decision reads that curve at the size a new strategy would trade.
differentiation.task305: task305 reads a forced choice's response from the members an existing limit already forces; here no member chooses and no limit forces anything: the evidence is the desk's executions, and the response read is a cost curve in each order's share of the stock's day, applied at a new size.
differentiation.task308: task308's second architecture carried an event's loss to a larger book claim by claim while repair capacity surged the cost of simultaneous claims; here there are no events, claims or repairers: each trade's cost is read off the desk's own order-level executions at that trade's own share of the stock's daily traded value, a square root in participation fitted on orders, and the decision funds one strategy whole.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the part of a candidate's second-round effect that stays inside the area, when that round runs through the incomes the candidate pays and a published multiplier carries the area's average share of those incomes spent at home; one candidate's earners mostly live outside the area, which only its operator's roster joined to a location lookup shows, so the multiplier credits it with spending that happens elsewhere and ranks it first.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at stage 2, before any data was cut: the survivor anatomy's Actor test failed on paper, since the deciding property (where the distribution centre's staff live) is one join from a column (the roster's postcode against the postcode directory's local authority) and any shipped residence datum is a column or a sentence, so the decisive rung would be readable; re-rooted into actuarial reinsurance capital

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is next year's failures in an asset base that keeps taking in old units the current roll does not hold yet: a forecast summed over today's roll leaves out the units still to arrive, which arrive past their cover and fail in their first months, so one segment's demand runs a fifth short and its share of a fixed capacity goes to the segments the roll overstates.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Voltwerk's 2027 EV pack refurbishment slots across five platforms, the used imports still to arrive)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at the batch 1 triage: shipped 10-24, determinism repair reshipped 10-26; its isolated cold reader landed the call (all five slots and the 3,800 total), and the design note named the decisive step reflex reachable (conditioning a survival curve on survival to the as-of date); re-rooted in a new world

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the tail of a forward loss distribution built from simulated years of events and calibrated to the organisation's own recorded losses, when an event that strikes within weeks of the event before it costs more per unit of modelled loss than an event on a quiet spell, a class no column marks and only the order of the record's events rebuilds; one pooled calibration across all events undercosts the later events of a run, which are the only ones a cover on second and later events pays on, and values that cover below its cost.
